description: A woman in a dark high-collared dress stands at right, raising a clenched fist and speaking, lit by a warm lamp. Around a round table with teacups, a teapot and loose papers sit five or six women in dark Edwardian dress, all turned toward her. The dim room has ornate patterned wallpaper, framed portraits on the walls, a door at left and a fireplace glowing at the right edge. No visible text, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.
